lmp: Kùù Nyùè yi yu foŋ àmbò fwàé rntaa ce e m ce roko sibaŋ.
eng: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' vùé nè ye, fa nè figâa yɛ"ni yò buu, wowèe a moo à rgèe tɛ a ka'se làr."
eng: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.

lmp: Wowèe à m làa enɛ̂, "E m jà" bèe mo", a moo à rjà" yi tu là"r. E yu ŋkuù bèe Isràèl; e suu là embe klìntaa sè"ni na, tɛ sèe bo byemi nè ye.
eng: He saved others, but he can't save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

lmp: E làé ntee njep Nyùk, banɛ Nyùk ka' koŋ ye, e fùr là ye efa fígà", njobee" e m làa enɛ è ye Muu Nyùk.
eng: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'

lmp: Yù" Tata yi yu wèr ye, njobee" Nyùè à ce màɛ enɛ m fe"shi nsuŋ mbòfmbof nnè figâa fùp. E tuu màɛ enɛ m du suŋ bèe ce a yu mbe shaf enɛ nfè" à ghɛɛ ce a be fùr wowèe efa shaf, tɛ bèe ce a fèp a yɛ buu, tɛ bèe ce bèe a ce jar nè wowèe a luŋ efa ŋga",
eng: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

lmp: ker suŋ àmbò nfè" ce Tata Nyùè be ghòni yii bèe.
eng: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.

lmp: Ŋwà rfaé" à kùtí a suŋ buu ce wowèe a m làa nè yii masà. Ntee yi yaŋ masà ŋwà ndap ca, e laa nè yii ŋwà rfaé" ca enɛ̂, "Dù nè à btase ba à btar mndap vù nè ŋgâa fùp, ba bèe ce a kepŋger, ba bèe ce a koo", ker ba mntàɛŋ."
eng: That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.'

lmp: Ŋwà rfaé" anà sè sùtí, a là enɛ̂, "Mmâ, mɛ̀ gèe yu ce wɛ̀ làa. Ndap à ba ruu ka"."
eng: The servant said, 'Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.'

lmp: Ŋwà rfaé" à kùtí a suŋ buu ce wowèe a m làa nè yii masà. Ntee yi yaŋ masà ŋwà ndap ca, e laa nè yii ŋwà rfaé" ca enɛ̂, "Dù nè à btase ba à btar mndap vù nè ŋgâa fùp, ba bèe ce a kepŋger, ba bèe ce a fèp, ker ba mntàɛŋ."
eng: That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.'

lmp: Ŋwà rfaé" anà sè sùtí, a là enɛ̂, "Masà, mɛ̀ gèe yuu ce wɛ̀ làa. Ndap à ba ruu ka"."
eng: The servant said, 'Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.'

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ àde" mò" efa bèe ce a be anà joo yuu kùù cubu à ya fikà" ka".
eng: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.

lmp: Wowèe a ke bo" byepkùù, ye yàp buu wɛ̀wɛ, ce gèe nloo msàsap à ndùŋŋi nà bèe anɛ wowèe a ríŋ à nloo sè. Yàp fígà" be kè ba gòr sè.
eng: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.

lmp: Yà fwàè ce e yu yàànli a màɛ bsii njobee" e byemi nè màɛ, be lùŋ. E ka" kùti njìnjì banɛ m be yu" rbòŋi nè ye ka" "
eng: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.
